description: Reduced native-model failure and repair from live workflows: RDS exists but a GlobalEnv training constant does not survive a fresh kernel. Original model transcripts and scientific datasets are omitted.

cells.code:
records <- read.csv('inputs/calibration.csv')
center <- mean(records$x)
fit <- stats::lm(y ~ I(x - center), data=records)
saveRDS(fit, 'outputs/model.rds')
writeLines('warm-only', 'outputs/report.txt')

restored <- readRDS('outputs/model.rds')
writeLines('cold-pending', 'outputs/report.txt')
prediction <- stats::predict(restored, newdata=data.frame(x=c(2,4)))

from pathlib import Path
report = Path('outputs/report.txt')
assert report.read_text(encoding='utf-8') == 'cold-pending\n'
report.write_text('failure-observed\n', encoding='utf-8')

fit_factory <- function(frame) {
  training_center <- mean(frame$x)
  stats::lm(y ~ I(x - training_center), data=frame)
}
repaired <- fit_factory(read.csv('inputs/calibration.csv'))
saveRDS(repaired, 'outputs/model.rds')
prediction <- stats::predict(repaired, newdata=data.frame(x=c(2,4)))
stopifnot(max(abs(prediction-c(5,9))) < 1e-10)
write(prediction, 'outputs/report.txt', ncolumns=2)

restored <- readRDS('outputs/model.rds')
previous <- scan('outputs/report.txt', quiet=TRUE)
stopifnot(max(abs(previous-c(5,9))) < 1e-10)
recipe <- environment(formula(restored))
stopifnot(!identical(recipe, globalenv()), exists('frame', recipe, inherits=FALSE), exists('training_center', recipe, inherits=FALSE))
stopifnot(nrow(eval(restored$call$data, recipe)) == 4)
reversed <- stats::predict(restored, newdata=data.frame(x=c(4,2)))
singleton <- stats::predict(restored, newdata=data.frame(x=2))
empty <- stats::predict(restored, newdata=data.frame(x=numeric(0)))
stopifnot(max(abs(reversed-c(9,5))) < 1e-10, abs(singleton-5) < 1e-10, is.numeric(empty), length(empty) == 0)
base::write(reversed, file='outputs/report.txt', ncolumns=2)
